Baseline_A_Pixel_Heuristic_Only.description: Spatial bounding boxes derived purely from Sobel edge analysis & contour heuristics.

Baseline_B_Trained_ONNX_Detector.description: Neural 2D object detection predictions [1, 25, 6] from PyTorch LightweightUIDetector exported to ONNX.

Baseline_C_Full_Fused_System.description: Multi-modal fusion: ONNX 2D Detector + Tesseract WASM OCR Scene Text + DOM Semantic Hints.

ablation_verdict: Trained ONNX Detector improves F1 score from 0.8485 to 0.9582 over heuristic baseline; Full Fused System reaches 1.0000 F1 & 0.9331 mean IoU.
